selection_order: most model-visible evidence-supported Chinese no-code answers
most model-visible evidence-supported answers across the development split
least service time and fewer backend requests on ties

counting.candidate_hit: Every required evidence group has a verified passage ID in the first 20 of at least one route, before refusal. Report each original route and their union.
counting.final_hit: Each required evidence group has a verified passage ID in the indicated prefix of ToolOutput.content.
counting.support: The actual ToolOutput.content contains a complete PDF-verified evidence substring for every group in the top five.
counting.wrong_code_and_page: Count separately when the first returned hit has a code outside the label set or a labeled code on an unaccepted PDF page. Also report any such hit in the top five.
counting.false_accept: Any evidence returned to a hard negative. Report completed and attempted denominators.
counting.false_refusal: no_results on a completed answerable call. Wrong evidence and infrastructure errors are separately countable.
counting.latency: One warmup per arm, fixed sequential question order, nearest-rank P50 and P95 over all attempted search calls including timeouts; exclude warmup and exact lookups. No cross-question vector or rewrite cache.
